title: Machine Learning
subject: ai-ds
description: Core supervised and unsupervised learning methods, model evaluation and generalisation, and an introduction to neural networks, with emphasis on the mathematics behind each algorithm.

units.title: Unit 1 · Supervised Learning
units.description: Regression and classification with linear models, decision trees and ensemble methods.

topics.title: Linear and Logistic Regression
topics.description: Ordinary least squares, the normal equation, gradient descent and logistic regression for binary classification.

documents.title: Linear and Logistic Regression — Lecture Notes
documents.description: OLS, MSE cost, the normal equation, gradient descent, the sigmoid function, log-loss and decision boundaries.

documents.title: Gradient Descent Worked Example
documents.description: Three iterations of batch gradient descent computed by hand, checked against the normal equation, with a learning-rate stability analysis.

topics.title: Decision Trees and Ensemble Methods
topics.description: Entropy, information gain and Gini impurity, ID3/C4.5/CART, pruning, bagging, random forests and boosting.

documents.title: Decision Trees and Ensemble Methods — Lecture Notes
documents.description: Split criteria with a worked information-gain calculation, tree pruning, bagging, random forests, AdaBoost and gradient boosting.

units.title: Unit 2 · Model Evaluation and Generalization
units.description: Why models fail to generalise, how regularisation helps, and how to measure performance reliably.

topics.title: Bias–Variance Trade-off and Regularization
topics.description: Underfitting and overfitting, the bias-variance decomposition, L1 and L2 regularisation, early stopping and dropout.

documents.title: Bias–Variance Trade-off and Regularization — Lecture Notes
documents.description: The bias-variance decomposition, diagnosing fit with learning curves, ridge versus lasso, the effect of lambda, early stopping and dropout.

topics.title: Evaluation Metrics and Cross-Validation
topics.description: Classification metrics from the confusion matrix, ROC and AUC, data splitting, k-fold cross-validation and data leakage.

documents.title: Classification Evaluation Metrics — Lecture Notes
documents.description: Confusion matrix, accuracy, precision, recall, F1 with a numeric worked example, ROC curves, AUC and regression metrics.

documents.title: Cross-Validation and Data Leakage — Lab Handout
documents.description: Train/validation/test splits, k-fold, stratified and nested cross-validation, and how to avoid data leakage with pipelines.

units.title: Unit 3 · Unsupervised Learning and Neural Networks
units.description: Finding structure in unlabelled data, and the fundamentals of training multilayer neural networks.

topics.title: Clustering and Dimensionality Reduction
topics.description: k-means, choosing k, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN and principal component analysis.

documents.title: Clustering and Dimensionality Reduction — Lecture Notes
documents.description: The k-means objective and algorithm with a worked example, elbow and silhouette methods, linkage criteria, DBSCAN and PCA.

topics.title: Neural Network Fundamentals
topics.description: Perceptrons, multilayer networks, activation functions, backpropagation, softmax with cross-entropy and optimisers.

documents.title: Neural Network Fundamentals — Lecture Notes
documents.description: Perceptron learning, MLPs, activation functions, backpropagation with a numeric example, vanishing gradients, softmax and SGD, momentum and Adam.
